messages:
Maria: Quick check — NZ-south region (nz-south-1) proxy + egress setup. Small POC this week, need owners and any blocking infra deps.

Jon (eng-platform): I'm listed as default owner for routing policy. What exactly do you need nailed down? SLOs? KMS?

Maria: Thanks — mainly: 1) who owns proxy config + cert rotation, 2) KMS residency for keys, 3) egress IPs for peering request, 4) any DB replica regions needed. Also need a code-review on the proxy helm chart (PR below).

Samira (eng-infra): I can take cert rotation & egress IPs. For KMS, we need compliance sign-off. cc @leo (eng-sre) for key residency.

Leo (eng-sre): KMS: we can generate keys in customer-managed KMS in the region but infra needs VPN + peering in place first. ETA ~ 3 days after peering is approved.

Maria: PR: https://git.redwood/svc/proxy/compare/PR-482. It's tiny — just add nz-south values and egress cidr list.

Jon (eng-platform): I'll review. Two quick asks: - make sure we set `routing.policy.prefer_local = true` for low-latency fallbacks - add a canary tag for 10% traffic

Samira (eng-infra): noted. Peering request ticket created: INT-9172 — please add egress CIDRs from PR. @infra-oncall FYI :eyes: 

Leo (eng-sre): DB replica — we *don't* need a full replica, just read-only metrics shard. Ops will standby if needed. If they do need replica, it's +2 weeks.

Maria: Okay. Ownership summary so far: proxy config + cert rotation = Samira; routing policy + canary = Jon; KMS residency coord = Leo; peering ticket = Samira. Anyone else? :hand: 

Ally (security): Quick note — if keys are customer-managed, we require KMS audit logs forwarded to SIEM. Can that be an automated policy? (small ask)

Samira (eng-infra): Yes, we'll wire audit logs. Adding a task in PR checklist.

Jon (eng-platform): I'll merge PR after a quick CI pass. If no objections, aiming to flip canary Friday EOD.

Maria: Perfect. If anything blocks peering or KMS, call it out here. Thanks all :rocket:
